dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey kid, what are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: I like playing by the god statue!

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: It's so big and so pretty.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Have you ever climbed to the top? I tried to climb it once but got told off by Grace.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Grace is a nice lady, I don't want to make her mad again.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: But if you go up there, I wanna hear what the view is like!
